title: After the Japanese Derby: The Rose Crown of a Generation

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: From here on—!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh!?
Flash-senpai, to think you had this much strength left...!
—However!!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I will not surrender the crown!
DAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A ferocious clash among champions!
She has gloriously triumphed in the greatest Derby in history!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Rose Kingdom--!!

text_block_list.name: The Rose Clan
text_block_list.text: “Wooooooooh!!”

text_block_list.name: The Rose Clan
text_block_list.text:
"The bud of our house has reached the pinnacle of her generation!"
"What a glorious triumph!" "Lady Rose—!"
"To think she even claimed the crown of the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Could it be...
Lady Rose has won... the Nippon Derby—

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how long we have dreamed of this day!
You have truly accomplished it...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I won...
That Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have... won...!
Yes, yeeesss, yes!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous cheer—today's blessings
belong to you, Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So you're the one sitting at the top of our generation—
But this isn't my End Phase yet...!
It's not over! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is deeply regrettable.
However... I gave it my absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Papa, Mama...
I have no regrets about this day.

Magnificently claiming the honor of Derby Horse Girl,
it's Rose Kingdom!
News of that spectacular feat spread through the world in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby was my lifelong aspiration.
Knowing that Lady Rose, who carries the House of Roses upon her shoulders, has claimed that title fills me with pride."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"From the bottom of my heart, congratulations.
And thank you."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To think a top trainer would send such an impassioned letter.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I must never forget these words as I continue pressing forward.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The clan, too, rejoices greatly.
You must have felt it yourself from the endless stream of congratulatory gifts arriving at our door.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It simply means...
that it was a victory of profound honor.

The great feat accomplished alongside Rose Kingdom
served as a true wind at our back.
Yet, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom was magnificent!
A sublime victory shoulder-to-shoulder with her clan's legacy!
However—I also want to draw your attention to her!

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash!
To think she would deliver such an incredible run!
It has seared itself into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
She used to blend into the background of her generation,
but now I can hardly wait for her next race!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Admittedly, Flash-san ran that day in particular as though she had received a massive buff.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During the race,
there was even a moment when I was instinctively overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
She throws herself into races with such incredible passion.
I'm truly looking forward to competing with her again.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, talking about Flash-san on this show too?
Ahaha, that makes me so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon-senpai—if I recall correctly, you share a room with Flash-senpai, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Flash-san worked insanely hard for the Nihon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heading out for runs at the crack of dawn, staying out right up to curfew at night...
She managed a schedule like that with flawless precision, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco would totally throw in the towel after three days~...
Wait, huh?! Speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has assembled, I see.
...? Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! We were just talking about the Japanese Derby.
Flash-san was so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Flash-senpai.
Regarding the Japanese Derby, you carried special sentiments—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —No, I sensed something far beyond that from you. Most certainly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
It was a race dedicated to my father and mother in Germany.
The way my parents live is both my dream and my guiding star.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I intended to offer proof of my growth
by claiming victory at the Tokyo Yushun...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Victory eluded me... But—
both Father and Mother praised me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was only possible because all of you were by my side.
—I thank you, from the depths of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san's running... that fierce heat.
It remains etched within my heart even now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It makes me almost regret our decision not to contend in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Like Pisa, I will not be running in the Kikuka Sho.
However, we will have our rematch somewhere down the line.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Consider yourself marked on my board
as a high-priority player.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again... that was a truly magnificent race,
Flash-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To be candid—I had never truly perceived
Flash-senpai as a formidable wall before.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Unnoticed by anyone, steadily preparing, only to magnificently demonstrate that power on the grand stage.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Trainer.

Her voice was calm, yet carried a subtle undercurrent of passion
that made me unconsciously pause my work.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have borne the hopes of our clan,
sprinting forward for the sake of our kingdom's founding and prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is a world where only the strong gather.
I knew well it would not be simple. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To be surrounded by such captivating rivals...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In particular—at the Satsuki Sho, just as promised,
Pisa brought about a magnificent circle among the stands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Flash-senpai, who made an indelible mark on the Japanese Derby with her latent strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Looking back now, before I realized it—
I must have harbored arrogance within myself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She is a descendant who shoulders the clan.
Thus, she believes she was blessed with the talent to found a kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in this arena,
I am by no means the sole power.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Their strength taught me that lesson.
This realization will surely nourish my growth henceforth.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why I feel it.
—I want to surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to stand as the representative of this golden generation.
Only then, surely, can I establish the prestige my house so desperately requires.

A gust of wind swept past.
Her eyes sparkled as if in response.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Our next race is the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown—
the Kikuka Sho.

Just as she said, our next battle is the final leg of the Classic
Triple Crown: the 3,000-meter turf race, the Kikuka Sho. A grueling
contest demanding stamina over a punishing course and long distance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“'The strongest horse girl wins'—
is that not an exquisitely fitting maxim?”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Neither Pisa nor Ruler are here.
Yet demonstrating one's true prowess does not necessarily require the presence of rivals on the track.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us claim a victory so dazzling
that even their phantom 'what-ifs' will not cross anyone's mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Upon the finale of the Classic Triple Crown road, I shall adorn it with a crimson rose.

Summer passes in the blink of an eye.
I must accomplish what needs to be done toward the Kikuka Sho.
